policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The combined rebased #128 and #176/#538/#550 client changes extend modal-history ownership, private navigation suppression, nested-modal accessibility, and navigation-ledger coverage in the instrumented client/core scope. Three clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-08-02 each passed all 2,011 tests across 243 files with zero unhandled errors and reproduced exactly 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). Relative to the reviewed #128 main baseline of 2,738/3,128 (87.532%), the combined tree adds 73 instrumented lines and 70 covered lines while increasing coverage percentage. The exact observed envelope needs no instrumentation tolerance, so the new floor is 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The integrated #606 prerequisite adds the process-local five-minute random prepare-handle owner and complete immutable semantic snapshot used between item-detail resolve and action prepare. The fixed-cap owner binds normalized actor, accessible-item/provider, operation/schema/generation, client capability/locale, private state/revision, configuration and catalog dimensions; reuses an exact live snapshot; enforces 24 entries per actor and 1,024 globally without cross-user eviction; and remains separate from the 60-second invoke capability. Final review additionally required raw lazy-enumeration caps, including duplicates, and raw-ASCII validation before explicit ASCII lowercase. Three clean successful Coverlet runs on the identical 2026-08-03 source and 44,447-line scope each passed all 3,085 server tests and observed 35,254, 35,253, and 35,252 covered lines. The two-line spread is confined to pre-existing timing-sensitive ImageBlurService.cs:740 and ReviewsStore.cs:216 paths; no prepare-owner line varied. Relative to the reviewed combined #591/#595 high-water of 34,744/43,927 (79.095%), the prerequisite adds 520 instrumented lines and raises the observed high-water by 510 covered lines to 35,254/44,447 (79.317%). The floor is the directly observed 35,252/44,447 minimum, exactly two lines below the maintained high-water. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
